name: Metro Inclusive Pharmacy
metaTitle: Metro Pharmacy: Pharmacy in Seminole Heights
metaDescription: Metro Inclusive Pharmacy at 5138 N. Florida Ave is open weekdays, with Tuesday until 6:00pm. The page describes Copay It Forward and 340B services.

publish.hoursNote: These are the Tampa counter hours printed on the pharmacy locations page. Tuesday stays open later than the other weekdays.

facts: Metro Inclusive Pharmacy, Seminole Heights, Tampa. The locations page lists Tampa at 5138 N. Florida Ave, Tampa, FL 33603, phone (813) 443-4854. That matches our listing. Website https://metrotampabay.org/about/locations/metro-inclusive-pharmacy/. Neighborhood /neighborhoods/seminole-heights.
Tampa hours on that page: Sunday CLOSED, Monday 8:00am – 4:30pm, Tuesday 8:00am – 6:00pm, Wednesday 8:00am – 4:30pm, Thursday 8:00am – 4:30pm, Friday 8:00am – 4:30pm, Saturday CLOSED.

The page describes Copay It Forward and 340B pharmacy services. It says $4M+ in free services for uninsured and underinsured patients since 2018. It lists free prescription delivery, same-day pickup, and up to $100 per month in copay support for eligible patients. It says these benefits are for patients receiving medical care from a METRO provider. It also says there are 60+ partner pharmacies, including CVS, Walgreens, and Publix.

METRO says it uses HIPAA-compliant dial-in translation, including Spanish, French, and Creole, plus ASL interpreting. It describes itself as a 501(c)3 nonprofit, Metropolitan Charities, inc. DBA Metro Healthy Communities, with 100+ programs. Email info@metrotampabay.org.

The same page also lists a St. Petersburg pharmacy at 2235 Central Avenue Ste. A and a New Port Richey pharmacy opening 1/1/27. Those clocks are a different door. Nearby from our coordinates: Ichiban Sushi 0.02 miles at 5127 N Florida Ave, slug ichiban-sushi-and-ramen. Seriously Strong Training 0.03 miles at 5120 N Florida Ave B, slug seriously-strong-training-tampa. Health Mutt 0.09 miles at 5023 N Florida Ave, slug health-mutt.

faq.a: The Tampa block says Tuesday runs until 6:00pm. Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday end at 4:30pm. Sunday and Saturday are marked closed.

faq.q: Who gets the copay support described on the page?
faq.a: The page says the Copay It Forward benefits are for patients receiving medical care from a METRO provider, and that eligible patients can receive up to $100 per month in copay support.

faq.q: Is this the St. Petersburg counter?
faq.a: No. This listing is 5138 N. Florida Ave in Tampa. The page also prints 2235 Central Avenue in St. Petersburg as a separate pharmacy.
